name: Ganxet
tagline: Board game timer for the whole table, with a clock facing each player
blurb: Ganxet is a timer for board games.
description:
Ganxet is a timer for board games. Put the phone in the middle of the table: each player sees their own clock, turned towards them. Tap anywhere on the screen to end your turn.

Two modes

• Time bank: each player has a time bank for the whole game, with an optional bonus after each turn and optional elimination at zero.

• Per turn: the clock restarts on every turn, and can pass automatically to the next player.

Features

• 2 to 8 players, seated clockwise around the screen

• Undo the last turn, pause with a long press, summary at the end of the game

• A game in progress is saved and can be resumed after the app is closed

• Optional Do Not Disturb during games

• Large text support, one shape per player color, screen reader support

• English, Catalan and French

No ads, no tracking, no network access.
